searchText: No, the testcases are hardcoded to expect a specific chain, it checks that the responses contain exactly the accounts / proofs it expects. So in order to test besu, you need to make besu import the blocks and then point snap-test to it. We have a hive-test which does exactly this, so ideally that test would just pass https://hivetests.ethdevops.io/suite.html?suiteid=1696153349-5fc711e3ab9c02568fcd45fb956bd219.json&suitename=snap#
